messages.content: My flight booking shows 'pending' even though I already paid. I need confirmation ASAP.

I'm sorry your booking is still pending after payment. Check your payment receipt and booking history. Do not pay again until the payment and booking status are verified. If the booking is still missing, contact the service's support team.
The hotel I booked looks nothing like the pictures. The room is smaller and not clean.

I'm sorry the room didn't meet your expectations. Document the issue and contact the booking provider or property to ask about available remedies. Any alternative or refund depends on the applicable booking policy.
My train ticket shows the wrong date even though I selected tomorrow.
I'm sorry the ticket shows the wrong date. Check your booking confirmation and the date selected during booking. Contact the provider promptly to ask whether a correction or change is allowed.
The bus I booked was canceled but I didn’t receive any refund update.

I'm sorry your bus was cancelled and you haven't received a refund update. Check the cancellation notice and payment history. Contact the booking provider to confirm the refund status and expected timeline; don't assume a refund has been processed.
My luggage hasn’t arrived even though the flight landed hours ago.
I'm sorry your luggage hasn't arrived. Contact the airline's baggage service at the airport and file a delayed-baggage report. Keep your baggage tag and report reference for follow-up.
My boarding pass isn’t generating on the app.

I'm sorry the boarding pass isn't appearing. Check your booking status and the airline's check-in requirements. If the app still fails, use the airline's official website or contact its support team for help.
The cab I booked for airport transfer never arrived and I almost missed my flight.

I'm sorry the airport cab didn't arrive and put your flight at risk. If you still need transport, use a verified alternative if it's safe and practical. Report the missed pickup through the booking service and request a review of any charges.
The train seat I was allotted is different from the one I selected.
I'm sorry your assigned seat differs from the one you selected. Check your booking confirmation and contact the train operator or booking provider to ask what options are available.
My hotel reservation says 'payment pending' even though my card was charged.

I'm sorry your hotel booking shows payment pending after your card was charged. Check your payment receipt and booking status. Don't pay again until the transaction is verified. Contact the booking provider if the status remains unresolved.
The cab I booked was extremely late and the driver didn’t answer calls.

I'm sorry the cab is late and the driver isn't answering. Check the ride status in the app and use its support or safety options if needed. If you still need transport, consider a verified alternative. Report the missed pickup to the provider.
